WITH visible_stage_rows AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT home_revision.payload AS payload 
FROM home_revision 
WHERE home_revision.kind = %(kind_1)s::VARCHAR AND home_revision.recorded_at < %(recorded_at_1)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE AND home_revision.superseded_at IS NULL)
 SELECT stage_fields_1.project_id, stage_fields_1.stage, stage_fields_1.status, stage_fields_1.selected 
FROM visible_stage_rows JOIN LATERAL json_to_record(visible_stage_rows.payload) AS stage_fields_1(project_id TEXT, stage TEXT, status TEXT, selected JSON, base_date TEXT) ON true 
WHERE stage_fields_1.base_date <= %(base_date_1)s::VARCHAR AND stage_fields_1.status IN (%(status_1_1)s::VARCHAR, %(status_1_2)s::VARCHAR)

SELECT home_revision.payload 
FROM home_revision 
WHERE home_revision.kind = %(kind_1)s::VARCHAR AND home_revision.recorded_at < %(recorded_at_1)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE AND home_revision.superseded_at IS NULL AND CAST((home_revision.payload ->> %(payload_1)s::TEXT) AS VARCHAR) = %(param_1)s::VARCHAR

SELECT home_batch.id, home_batch.source_id, home_batch.started_at, home_batch.finished_at, home_batch.status, home_batch.stats, home_batch.error, home_batch.manifest 
FROM home_batch 
WHERE home_batch.id IN (SELECT anon_1.id 
FROM (SELECT home_batch.id AS id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY home_batch.source_id ORDER BY home_batch.started_at DESC) AS rn 
FROM home_batch 
WHERE home_batch.source_id IN (%(source_id_1_1)s::VARCHAR, %(source_id_1_2)s::VARCHAR, %(source_id_1_3)s::VARCHAR, %(source_id_1_4)s::VARCHAR, %(source_id_1_5)s::VARCHAR, %(source_id_1_6)s::VARCHAR, %(source_id_1_7)s::VARCHAR, %(source_id_1_8)s::VARCHAR, %(source_id_1_9)s::VARCHAR, %(source_id_1_10)s::VARCHAR, %(source_id_1_11)s::VARCHAR, %(source_id_1_12)s::VARCHAR, %(source_id_1_13)s::VARCHAR, %(source_id_1_14)s::VARCHAR, %(source_id_1_15)s::VARCHAR, %(source_id_1_16)s::VARCHAR, %(source_id_1_17)s::VARCHAR, %(source_id_1_18)s::VARCHAR, %(source_id_1_19)s::VARCHAR) AND home_batch.status = %(status_1)s::VARCHAR AND home_batch.finished_at < %(finished_at_1)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE) AS anon_1 
WHERE anon_1.rn = %(rn_1)s::INTEGER)
